auth.note: Nothing publishes until the quality gate has read it.

signIn.title: Your queue kept <accent>filling</accent> itself.
signIn.blurb: Autopilot does not wait for you to log in. Anything it wrote while you were away is in the pipeline, already through the quality gate.
signIn.footer: No account yet? <link>Start with your website</link>

signUp.title: Give it your website. <accent>Keep</accent> the rest of your day.
signUp.blurb: One URL is all it needs. Contivo reads your site into a brand memory, maps the competitors you actually have, and only then starts writing.
signUp.fineprint: Free while Contivo is in early access. No card, and nothing publishes anywhere until you connect a channel yourself.
signUp.siteNote: It is filled in for you in the first step after this.

social.label: Sign in with a provider
social.fineprint: By continuing you agree to our <terms>Terms of use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy page</privacy>, and an account is created if you do not have one yet.

oauthErrors.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled and nothing changed. You can try again, or use your email.
oauthErrors.invalid_state: That sign-in expired or was opened in a different browser or tab. Start again from here.
oauthErrors.provider_error: The provider could not finish the sign-in. Try again in a moment, or use your email.
oauthErrors.no_verified_email: We need an email address the provider has confirmed, and it did not give us one. Confirm an email with the provider (for GitHub, add and verify one in its settings), then try again.
oauthErrors.email_in_use: An account with this email already exists. If it is yours, sign in the way you did before, then connect the provider in Settings. If you did not create it, <contact>contact us</contact>.
oauthErrors.suspended: This account has been suspended. Contact support.
oauthErrors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
